# GetHired

> GetHired (https://gethired.devhub.co.in) is an AI job platform for tech roles. Job seekers chat with an AI agent that searches thousands of developer and tech openings, matches them to their resume, reviews their CV and runs mock interviews. Companies get an AI recruiter that drafts job posts, ranks matched candidates, screens applicants with AI interviews and runs a lightweight ATS.

Every page listed here has a markdown version: add `.md` to the URL (the home page is `/index.md`). The links below point to the markdown versions.

## Job seekers

- [Home](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/index.md): The AI job-search agent and what it does
- [AI resume checker](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/ai-resume-checker.md): Resume feedback for a target role
- [AI interview practice](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/ai-interview.md): Mock interviews with feedback
- [Browse jobs](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/jobs): Current job listings, searchable by role, skill and location (HTML only)

## Companies

- [Hire tech talent](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/hire.md): The AI recruiter, candidate matching, screening and pipeline
- [Pricing for companies](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/pricing/companies.md): Plans, prices and what each includes

## Integrations

- [MCP server](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/mcp-server.md): Connect Claude to GetHired job search and resume tools
- [Introducing the GetHired MCP Server](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/blog/introducing-the-get-hired-mcp-server.md): What the MCP server does and how to set it up
- [Chrome extension](https://gethired.devhub.co.in/extension.md): Fills in job applications from your GetHired profile (coming soon)
